title: Apollo 11 Moon Landing
description:
**Apollo 11** was the American spaceflight that first landed humans on the Moon. Commander Neil Armstrong and lunar module pilot Buzz Aldrin landed the Apollo Lunar Module Eagle on July 20, 1969.

Armstrong became the first person to step onto the lunar surface six hours and 39 minutes later on July 21; Aldrin joined him 19 minutes later. They spent about two and a quarter hours together outside the spacecraft, and they collected 47.5 pounds of lunar material to bring back to Earth.

"That's one small step for man, one giant leap for mankind" - Neil Armstrong's famous words as he stepped onto the Moon.
